title: Enhancing chest X-ray report generation with pathology-guided prompts and vision-language shortcut bias mitigation
excerpt: This work proposes a framework for automated chest X-ray report generation using pathology-guided prompts and shortcut bias mitigation techniques integrated into a finetuned vision-language model (BLIP).
citation: Mohammad Barzegar, Habib Rostami, Amir Sanati, Rezvan Afshoon, Abolghasem Kosari, Ahmad Keshavarz. (2026). "Enhancing chest X-ray report generation with pathology-guided prompts and vision-language shortcut bias mitigation." Biomedical Signal Processing and Control.

title: Low and high dimensional wavelet thresholds for matrix-variate normal distribution
venue: Communications in Statistics - Theory and Methods
excerpt: This paper studies low- and high-dimensional wavelet thresholding approaches for matrix-variate normal distributions using Stein’s unbiased risk estimate and preprocessing strategies for missing values.
citation: H Karamikabir, A Sanati, GG Hamedani. (2024). "Low and high dimensional wavelet thresholds for matrix-variate normal distribution." Communications in Statistics - Theory and Methods. pp. 1-20.

title: The effectiveness of deep learning vs. traditional methods for lung disease diagnosis using chest X-ray images: A systematic review
excerpt: This systematic review evaluates and categorizes deep learning and traditional machine learning approaches for lung disease diagnosis using chest X-ray images.
citation: Samira Sajed, Amir Sanati, Jorge Esparteiro Garcia, Habib Rostami, Ahmad Keshavarz, Andreia Teixeira. (2023). "The effectiveness of deep learning vs. traditional methods for lung disease diagnosis using chest X-ray images: A systematic review." Applied Soft Computing. 110817.
